title: git init vs rm -rf .git: what is a Git repo? #shorts #git
description:
git init turns any folder into a repository by creating the hidden .git folder, where objects, refs and HEAD keep your whole history. Delete .git and every commit is gone.

Full episode: "Git Repository & git init Explained Simply | Git & GitHub Ep 3" on the Tech-dev channel.
